name: Disco Party

features.name: Pick your character
features.description: Male lead (medium) or female lead (low) volatility.

features.name: Adaptive symbols
features.description: High-paying symbols change to match your choice.

review:
Disco Party is a nightclub dating game with a twist: you choose your volatility by choosing your character. The male lead plays at medium volatility and the female lead at low, and the high-paying symbols adapt to match your choice.

Two free spins rounds multiply your winning matchups. Like Diamond of Jungle, it uses 243 ways and shares the same 1,500x maximum and 97.01% RTP. BGaming's table lists it as low volatility. Free spins arrive about once every 123 spins on average, and bonus buys are available where permitted. The character-based volatility choice is a neat idea for players still learning what volatility means.
pros: Excellent 97.01% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 123 spins on average)
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
